cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This doesn't seem to be equivalent to the initial code since r moves from slot 0 to 2, and b to 2 from 0. Is that expected?

Also, you could move these assignments in the `if a > 0 { ... }` block.

evidence.thread_resolution:
sagudev: Ah, apparently wrench (un)premutiply also converts rgba->bgra (swaps r and g), but we can just reverse that.
shalvin: Fixed in the latest update so the r & g values don’t swap. Also moved assignments into the `if` block.
